t1.text: Baaz sidebar on the fluid-design tokens — Fluid Functionalism's neutral ladder, shadows and motion, Inter, radii one step tighter (rows 6, menus 10). Dark, 256 px (FF 16rem).

n1.text:
Tweaks on the Sidebar board: bylines all ↔ status only, row height 32 ↔ 36, row text 13 ↔ 14. Rows rest muted and light to foreground on hover or selection; selected titles are semibold.

Browse mode follows Yet Another Browser: the page spans the full height with no header; address, page controls, New tab, pinned, tabs, folders and spaces all live in the sidebar.
